title: Kuafu Chases the Sun

source.book: Classic of Mountains and Seas, Northern Lands Beyond the Sea
source.quote: Kuafu raced the sun. Thirsty, he drank the Yellow River and the Wei, and when those were not enough he set off for the great marsh, but died of thirst on the way. His staff, cast aside, became a grove of peach trees.

moral: He never caught the sun, but his staff grew into a grove of peach trees.
